evidence.note: Difficulty-Aware Stochastic Interpolant Policy (DA-SIP) lets a diffusion/flow-based robot control policy adaptively choose its integration step budget, solver, and ODE/SDE mode per control step based on a difficulty classifier over RGB-D observations, cutting computation 2.6-4.4x with comparable task success.
evidence.title: Dynamic Test-Time Compute Scaling in Control Policy: Difficulty-Aware Stochastic Interpolant Policy
